diagnosis.preamble: Times are seconds of game time: one native tick is 34 ms, and every model decision holds one of six inputs for 15 ticks (0.51 s); the game pauses while the model decides. Gravity can be flipped only while standing on a floor or ceiling.

harness.trigger_rule: every model decision: the request is rendered from the state with the 9x9 local rows showing solid and spike cells as clear; the trigger is the first decision at which this changes the request (decision 0 from the start)
harness.changed_artifact: localSolidRows in the model request (solid '#' and spike '!' cells rendered as clear '.')

controller.trigger_rule: every model decision whose selected input has a horizontal direction (left, right, flip_left, flip_right): left and right are exchanged after the selection; the trigger is the first such decision
controller.changed_artifact: native input sent to the game (left and right exchanged; flip edges kept)

release_rules.frozen: 2026-11-26 01:12 PST (San Diego), before the first release attempt; brief experiments/exp0/20261126_0045_vvvvvv_v0_collection/BRIEF.md
release_rules.episode: variant A: start at the native Space Station 1 time-trial start (room [113,105] 'Welcome Aboard', after the native 165-tick countdown); win = the player enters a room other than [113,105] and [114,105] 'Conundrum'; a death respawns the player at the game's checkpoint (the death animation runs as `auto` rows of `wait` windows, no model call) and the episode goes on; timeout = 150 model decisions
release_rules.request: the merged integration's own run.request_for: rule text + the full bridge observation; 6 raw inputs, each held 15 native ticks (0.51 s); no autopilot, no hidden or ranked options
release_rules.game: the pinned original build code/exp0/games/vvvvvv/build/VVVVVV (no speed-up bridge, no developer hooks, no lookahead)
release_rules.selection: seeded sampling from the model's probabilities (contract.Sampler), one fixed policy seed per reset group, shared by the group's four conditions
release_rules.groups: s01-s10 initial (seeds 1-10), s11-s16 reserves (seeds 11-16) in listed order; one layout only, so the groups are correlated (#185: extra seeds do not establish new layouts)
release_rules.scored_selection: Griddly v0 PROTOCOL.md line 9 as implemented by code/exp0/common/audit_set.py choose(): per slot the first eligible attempt; the first ten listed groups per condition; interventions non-wins first in plan order; controls the first ten, swapping in one of the other outcome when all ten share an outcome
release_rules.reserves: collected only (a) for a slot of an initial group that has no eligible attempt after its attempt cap (failed validation, incomplete, untriggered fault, missing evidence), in listed reserve order and for that condition only; or (b) for controls, when all ten initial controls share one outcome: reserve controls in listed order until one of the other outcome exists. An intervention win does not by itself trigger reserves (as Griddly)
release_rules.response_tries: 2 per decision (the identical request again after a rejected reply)
release_rules.concurrency: at most 4 game instances: three clean-model streams (one per condition) on 8813, the weights stream on 8814

budgets.collection_wall_hours_estimate: 0.8-1.0 (40 attempts; pilot: 1.9 s per call on 8813 with three clients, 0.10 s per window, ~315 s per 150-decision attempt)
budgets.codex_calls: 80 primary (read + probe, run first) + 40 pre-registered probe variant (diagnosis_prompt_probe_variant.txt)
budgets.laya_calls_outside_episodes: weights re-ask <= 4 per weights attempt; probes <= 2 x 2 x 4 per episode

diagnosis_prompts.primary: code/exp0/common/diagnosis_prompt.txt (Griddly's prompt, game nouns only; P59 option A)
diagnosis_prompts.variant: code/exp0/common/diagnosis_prompt_probe_variant.txt (primary + one sentence; probe mode only; reported separately)

release_rules.history: phase 1 (2026-11-23) inspected pilot groups p01-p04 (seeds 9001-9004) and dev probes (seeds 1000+, 3000+, 4000+); the 2026-11-26 persistent-fault pilot re-used p01. None of the release seeds 1-16 was run before the freeze
